game_concept: A action defense set in The Kingdom – Festival Grounds, the festival grounds: the herald must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Memory Map: Place variable cards on a memory board so the throne reads the right value at run time.
theme: The Kingdom – Festival Grounds: the festival grounds
core_gameplay_loop: In Festival Grounds, repeat each round: Place variable cards on a memory board so the throne reads the right value at run time. Each round, siege rats strike the throne, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the y value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the throne from siege rats in Festival Grounds: keep the y meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: y drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Memory Map
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Memory Map' (Week 1 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Festival Grounds'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how y changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Festival Grounds.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 24 seconds while y > 0.
